cues.en: Hello again, let's go ahead and now create the client portion of the AGUI to continue our server that we created in the previous video as well.

cues.zh: 那就開始吧。

cues.zh: 先存檔，接著放入程式本身。

cues.zh: 回到 Program.cs，移除預設內容，再來逐段分析。

cues.en: This is the important part to show you exactly what's going on, so bear with me here.
cues.zh: 這部分很重要，要讓你看清楚到底發生什麼事，請跟著我看。

cues.en: First of all, I'm going to bring in an instance of an HTTP client.
cues.zh: 首先建立一個 HttpClient 執行個體。

cues.en: I'm going to create an object of the HTTP client here in .NET and the server, based on what I created for the AGUI server demo, is going to run on localhost 5000.
cues.zh: 也就是在 .NET 中建立 HttpClient 物件。依照前一個 AG-UI Server Demo，伺服器會在 localhost:5000 執行。

cues.en: Once I do that, what I would like to do is to create what we call a chat client, but it's not based on Azure OpenAI or anything like that.
cues.zh: 接著我要建立一個對話用戶端，但不是基於 Azure OpenAI 或其他模型供應商。

cues.en: I just would like to go create a chat client based on the AGUI chat client passing in the HTTP client going to localhost 5000 right there.
cues.zh: 而是建立 AGUIChatClient，傳入這個指向 localhost:5000 的 HttpClient。

cues.en: Notice here that I am counting from the user interface.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡是從使用者介面這一端出發。

cues.en: This could be any kind of user interface, Angular, Vue, Next.js, React, whatever you would like.
cues.zh: 使用者介面可以是 Angular、Vue、Next.js、React，或你喜歡的任何技術。

cues.en: But the instance here, I'm doing it in .NET itself, so I'm going to create a chat client going against the localhost 5000 in here to create an instance of that client.
cues.zh: 這個例子則直接使用 .NET，建立一個指向 localhost:5000 的對話用戶端執行個體。

cues.en: So I'm not creating anything in Azure OpenAI or anything else.
cues.zh: 所以我沒有在 Azure OpenAI 或其他服務中建立任何東西。

cues.en: I'm counting on the instance coming back from the AGUI server itself that I just created in the previous video. All right.
cues.zh: 而是依賴上一支影片建立的 AG-UI 伺服器所提供的執行個體。

cues.en: The main secret in here is the line number 11 in here.
cues.zh: 這裡的關鍵就在第 11 行。

cues.en: I'm going to create an agent, but remember, that agent is already available on the server.
cues.zh: 我要建立代理程式，但記得，真正的代理程式其實已經存在於伺服器上。

cues.en: So why am I creating an agent here on the client?
cues.zh: 那為什麼又在用戶端建立一個代理程式？

cues.en: Well, I'm going to be using this as a proxy.
cues.zh: 因為這裡要把它當成 proxy，也就是代理物件。

cues.en: So I'm not creating an agent on the client in here.
cues.zh: 所以並不是在用戶端重新建立真正的代理程式，

cues.en: I'm just creating a proxy.
cues.zh: 而是建立它的代理物件。

cues.en: So when I say AI agent in here and go to the chat client which came back from the localhost 5000 as an AI agent, remember, on the server I mapped the AGUI to slash, that means the root,
cues.zh: 因此，這裡宣告 AIAgent，再對來自 localhost:5000 的對話用戶端呼叫 AsAIAgent。記得，伺服器上已經把 AG-UI 對應到斜線，也就是根路徑，

cues.en: and I will bring you back the agent.
cues.zh: 並提供那個代理程式。

cues.en: So whenever the call comes in, we're going to give you an instance of that agent.
cues.zh: 所以每當請求進來，就會交給那個代理程式執行個體。

cues.en: That means this is just a proxy.
cues.zh: 也就是說，這裡只是它的代理物件。

cues.en: And I'm going to give it instructions.
cues.zh: 接著我會給它一些指示：

cues.en: You are a helpful assistant that can also change the color of the text in the console.
cues.zh: 「你是一位樂於助人的助理，也能變更主控台文字的顏色。」

cues.en: Use the change color tool to change the color when needed to enhance.
cues.zh: 「需要加強呈現效果時，請使用 ChangeColor 工具改變顏色。」

cues.en: This is something that I feel like would be difficult for me to do in code myself.
cues.zh: 如果要自己撰寫這整套流程，我會覺得相當麻煩，

cues.en: So this is really the amazing part.
cues.zh: 所以這正是很厲害的地方。

cues.en: The amazing part in here, folks, is that on the client, even though this is a proxy going, the back end will do all the work, look what happens when I go all the way to the bottom in here
cues.zh: 各位，精彩的部分在這裡：雖然用戶端拿到的是代理物件，實際工作會由後端處理，但看看我來到最下方，

cues.en: and I'm going to create a function on the client itself.
cues.zh: 直接在用戶端建立一個函式。

cues.en: I'm going to say void change color, and I'm going to be passing a color in here.
cues.zh: 函式是 void ChangeColor，傳入一個顏色，

cues.en: And what I'm going to do is I'm going to change the console foreground color to whatever color I'm going to be passing.
cues.zh: 接著將 Console.ForegroundColor 改成傳入的顏色。

cues.en: I want you to comprehend what I'm doing in here.
cues.zh: 我希望你了解，這裡做的是什麼。

cues.en: I'm creating a function on the client, even though the back end is the one that contains all the real implementation of that agent.
cues.zh: 真正的代理程式實作都在後端，但我卻在用戶端建立函式。

cues.en: And the reason why I'm showing you this is because when I created the proxy, I gave it another tool, which is the change color all the way at the bottom.
cues.zh: 之所以這樣示範，是因為建立代理物件時，我又加入一個工具，就是最下方的 ChangeColor。

cues.en: Do you have any idea what I'm doing right now, folks, is that not only will I be able to make the call on the proxy and then it will delegate it all the way to the server to run it
cues.zh: 你知道這代表什麼嗎？不只可以透過代理物件呼叫伺服器，由伺服器執行，

cues.en: and stream it back into the client, but I may even call a function that the server doesn't know anything about, because the proxy will be able to use the power of the back end agent
cues.zh: 再把結果串流傳回用戶端；甚至還能呼叫一個伺服器原先完全不知道的函式，因為代理物件能運用後端代理程式的能力，

cues.en: to still find this tool and run it on the client itself.
cues.zh: 找到這個工具，並在用戶端本身執行。

cues.en: That is pretty impressive, as a matter of fact.
cues.zh: 這其實相當令人驚豔。

cues.en: After that, I'm going to go ahead and create the list for the chat messages as an array, and then we'll do a while true.
cues.zh: 接著建立 ChatMessage 清單，然後執行 while (true) 迴圈，

cues.en: So we're going to ask a lot of questions during the session as well.
cues.zh: 讓我們能在同一個工作階段中持續提出問題。

cues.en: If you, of course, do not pass anything in the read line, we're going to go ahead and exit that.
cues.zh: 當然，如果 ReadLine 沒有讀到任何輸入，就離開迴圈。

cues.en: And I'm going to actually take whatever message you gave me on the command line, by the read line, I'm going to go ahead and put it in the messages array so that I can pass it on later on
cues.zh: 我會把從命令列透過 ReadLine 取得的訊息，加入 messages 清單，稍後再一起傳給

cues.en: to the runAsync or the runStreamingAsync.
cues.zh: RunAsync 或 RunStreamingAsync。

cues.en: The important part in here is that the updates that keep coming in from the server, I'm going to put that in an updates variable, which is a list of the agent response update coming back.
cues.zh: 這裡的重點是，從伺服器持續傳來的更新，會放進 updates 變數，也就是 AgentResponseUpdate 清單。

cues.en: So for each agent response update, I'm going to be running the streamingAsync, passing the questions that I asked on the command line, and I'm going to go ahead and add this to the updates array that I've created.
cues.zh: 呼叫 RunStreamingAsync，傳入命令列中提出的問題，再將每一個 AgentResponseUpdate 加入剛建立的 updates 清單。

cues.en: And then for each AI content in all the update contents coming in, I'm going to look for a switch.
cues.zh: 接著，對每個更新中包含的 AIContent，使用 switch 判斷，

cues.en: And there is multiple things that you can look for.
cues.zh: 有幾種不同的內容類型可以處理。

cues.en: The first one, if the server sent back the answer, that is the case for the content being a text content.
cues.zh: 第一種是伺服器傳回回答，也就是內容類型為 TextContent 的情況，

cues.en: So I'm going to go ahead and write the entire answer directly on the console app.
cues.zh: 我會直接把完整回答印在主控台應用程式中。

cues.en: But if it's making a function call and it actually sends me information about which function call is being used, I'm going to go ahead and create a string builder.
cues.zh: 但如果是在呼叫函式，並傳回正在使用哪個函式的資訊，我就建立一個 StringBuilder，

cues.en: I'm going to tell you which tool call is being called.
cues.zh: 顯示目前呼叫的是哪個工具。

cues.en: For instance, remember the server has the getWeather.
cues.zh: 例如，記得伺服器上有 GetWeather，

cues.en: That's the only tool available on the server.
cues.zh: 那是伺服器目前唯一的工具。

cues.en: And then there is another one called changeColor, which is available on the client.
cues.zh: 另外還有一個 ChangeColor，則存在於用戶端。

cues.en: So I want to find out which function call is being called, so it will tell me the name of the function call.
cues.zh: 所以我想知道，究竟呼叫哪個函式，讓它顯示函式名稱，

cues.en: And then I'm going to go ahead and show you all the arguments, like the city, for instance, when I'm asking what is the weather in Paris.
cues.zh: 再列出所有引數。例如詢問巴黎天氣時，引數就是城市 Paris。

cues.en: So it needs to send me back this information about what the function call arguments is all about.
cues.zh: 因此，需要取得這次函式呼叫所使用的引數資訊。

cues.en: I'm going to append all that stuff again to the end of the array.
cues.zh: 我會再將這些資料附加到後面，

cues.en: And then I'm going to right-line the entire content of the tool call details that I created in the string builder.
cues.zh: 最後透過 WriteLine，顯示 StringBuilder 中整理的完整工具呼叫細節。

cues.en: All right, so this is just to make sure that we know which function call gets called and from where, whether it's from the client or from the server, using the proxy on the client.
cues.zh: 這只是為了讓我們知道，透過用戶端代理物件時，究竟呼叫了哪個函式，以及它是在用戶端還是伺服器端。

cues.en: Then we have the function result.
cues.zh: 接著是函式結果，

cues.en: This is now what is the result that came back from accessing that tool.
cues.zh: 也就是實際存取工具後傳回的結果。

cues.en: So the text content is coming from the LLM.
cues.zh: 因此，TextContent 是 LLM 產生的內容，

cues.en: The function call content is who's being called and what argument is being passed to it.
cues.zh: FunctionCallContent 則說明呼叫了誰，以及傳入了哪些引數，

cues.en: And the function result content is what did the tool return back, like, for instance, the sunny and 72 degrees, before it even goes to the LLM itself.
cues.zh: FunctionResultContent 則是工具實際傳回的資料，例如晴天、72 度，而且這是在資料交給 LLM 之前的結果。

cues.en: And, of course, if there is an exception or an error or something, I'm still going to go ahead and show you the error.
cues.zh: 當然，如果有例外、錯誤或其他問題，我也會將錯誤顯示出來。

cues.en: If there is no error, I'm going to go ahead and show you the tool result, the information that came back from the tool.
cues.zh: 如果沒有錯誤，就顯示工具結果，也就是工具傳回的資訊。

cues.en: And finally, if there is an exception in the whole process, I'm going to bubble it up so you can see it.
cues.zh: 最後，如果整個流程發生例外，也會往外傳遞，讓你看到。

cues.en: So these are the events that are being triggered, really, from the server regarding the HEUI that you can capture on the client in here as well.
cues.zh: 因此，這些就是透過 AG-UI 從伺服器觸發、而用戶端可以接收的事件。

cues.en: All right, at the end, we will do the full response, and we will use the array that we created for the updates that we keep adding to it, to agent response.
cues.zh: 好，最後要取得完整回應，將持續累積更新的清單，透過 ToAgentResponse 整理成完整的 AgentResponse。

cues.en: And then I'm going to add the add range for the full respondent messages to my messages array as well.
cues.zh: 接著將完整回應中的訊息，透過 AddRange 加入 messages 清單。

cues.en: And that's about it.
cues.zh: 大致就是這樣。

cues.en: So I should actually be able to get an answer for what I'm asking with no problem whatsoever.
cues.zh: 因此，應該就能順利取得問題的答案。

cues.en: I think the code in here is understandable, that we're creating a client that does not have access to the real agent or all the code on the back end.
cues.zh: 這段程式碼應該很好理解：我們建立的用戶端，並沒有直接持有真正的代理程式或後端完整實作。

cues.en: Once I actually set it up to actually get a proxy against the localhost 5000 on the server for HEUI, I create this proxy for that agent, even though I'm giving it instructions and tools
cues.zh: 當我設定它連接 localhost:5000 上的 AG-UI 伺服器，就會建立那個代理程式的 proxy；即使我又給它指示、工具，

cues.en: and all of that stuff.
cues.zh: 或其他設定，概念也一樣。

cues.en: Notice I didn't tell it that I want to use GPT-5 or anything like that.
cues.zh: 注意，我沒有告訴它要使用 GPT-5 或其他模型，

cues.en: That will happen on the server side.
cues.zh: 那些都會由伺服器端處理。

cues.en: I think the most important thing that I really would like you to comprehend is this line here, number 13.
cues.zh: 我最希望你理解的是這裡的第 13 行，

cues.en: That's a big deal for us, which is I'm actually adding a tool on the client side.
cues.zh: 這對我們非常重要：我是在用戶端加入工具。

cues.en: Okay, the server has never seen this before, but the proxy will still respect it and will be able to make that tool available to the agent, even though that is available on the client side.
cues.zh: 伺服器之前完全沒見過這個工具，但 proxy 仍然會遵循設定，讓代理程式能使用它，即使工具本身是在用戶端。

cues.en: Amazing feature for HEUI to be able to do something like this.
cues.zh: 這是 AG-UI 很驚人的一項能力。

cues.en: All right, let's go ahead and run all of this for right now.
cues.zh: 好，現在來執行整個範例。

cues.zh: 先在這裡輸入 cd 29，進入伺服器專案，再執行 dotnet run。

cues.en: We have to run the server before we do anything else, and we're going to wait until it's running on localhost 5000.
cues.zh: 一定要先啟動伺服器，再進行其他操作，並等它開始在 localhost:5000 執行。

cues.en: Let's do that, and then while it's doing that, let me go ahead and save this file.
cues.zh: 執行後，趁它啟動時，先儲存這個檔案。

cues.zh: 好，可以看到已經在 localhost:5000 執行。

cues.zh: 我會讓它繼續開著，

cues.en: Don't close this, otherwise, of course, it's not going to work.
cues.zh: 不要關掉，否則當然就無法運作。

cues.en: So I'm going to go to the other instance, and in here we'll go ahead and say .NET run in English.
cues.zh: 接著到另一個 PowerShell 執行個體，這裡同樣輸入 dotnet run。

cues.en: All right, .NET run, and we'll run this guy, and then again right now the client is starting, and this could be a full-blown user interface in whatever language or whatever frameworks
cues.zh: 好，執行 dotnet run，讓用戶端啟動。這一端也可以是完整的使用者介面，使用你喜歡的語言或框架，

cues.en: you would like to use from inside of .NET in here.
cues.zh: 不一定要像這裡一樣直接使用 .NET 主控台。

cues.en: That's fine with me, and then it's asked me to ask my first question.
cues.zh: 都沒有問題。接著它會請我輸入第一個問題。

cues.en: So again, we know that there is a get weather, so we'll go ahead and say what is the weather in Paris, and if I run this, again, the events that I showed you in here,
cues.zh: 我們知道有 GetWeather 工具，所以詢問：「巴黎的天氣如何？」執行後，先前展示的這些事件，

cues.en: on the client, will end up using the proxy.
cues.zh: 就會在用戶端透過代理物件運作。

cues.en: You see the tool call is get weather, going to the server, city is Paris.
cues.zh: 可以看到工具呼叫是 GetWeather，交給伺服器執行，City 是 Paris，

cues.en: This is the argument being passed to it.
cues.zh: 這就是傳入的引數。

cues.en: The tool result returned back, it is sunny and 72 degrees.
cues.zh: 工具傳回的結果是晴天、72 度。

cues.en: This is the second line in here, this is this one here, the case for the function result content, okay?
cues.zh: 這就是這裡的第二行，也就是 FunctionResultContent 的處理分支。

cues.en: So the first one, the tool call was called.
cues.zh: 第一個事件表示工具被呼叫，

cues.en: The second one, this function result content came back, and then finally the LLM got everything and returned the text content.
cues.zh: 第二個是 FunctionResultContent 傳回結果，最後 LLM 收到所有資訊，再傳回 TextContent。

cues.en: The text content case is this, it is sunny and 72 degrees in Paris.
cues.zh: TextContent 的內容就是：「巴黎現在天氣晴朗，氣溫 72 度。」

cues.en: It did a pretty good job.
cues.zh: 它做得很不錯，

cues.en: Hopefully that makes sense.
cues.zh: 希望這樣說明很清楚。

cues.en: It's not too complicated to see how the communication is going between the client and the server.
cues.zh: 用戶端與伺服器之間如何通訊，應該不難理解。

cues.en: The part that actually blew my mind away is that when I came back in here and say, change the color to red.
cues.zh: 真正讓我驚豔的是，我回到這裡，輸入：「把顏色改成紅色。」

cues.en: Look what happens when I do that.
cues.zh: 看看執行後會發生什麼事。

cues.en: Even though spelling changed wrong, still the system is smart enough to know what I'm doing.
cues.zh: 即使我把 change 拼錯，系統還是能理解我的意思。

cues.en: Notice it came back and it used the tool available on the client that the server has never seen before, and it started changing the color for the console, like I told it all the way at the bottom in here,
cues.zh: 注意，它使用的是存在於用戶端、伺服器從未見過的工具，並依照這裡最下方的程式碼，開始修改主控台顏色，

cues.en: console foreground color.
cues.zh: 也就是 Console.ForegroundColor。

cues.en: That part is amazing to me, and the amount of things that I can do with something like this by adding functionality and tools into the proxy on the client
cues.zh: 這部分真的很棒。我可以在用戶端的 proxy 上加入各種功能與工具，

cues.en: that will still use the GPT-5 power of the agent on the server side to execute it, that is pretty amazing, all right?
cues.zh: 卻仍然運用伺服器端代理程式的 GPT-5 能力來執行，這實在令人驚豔。

cues.en: Hopefully that gives you a pretty good idea about how to deal with AGUI on the server and the client, and I really look forward to see what people will be able to create with this technology and make it really shine.
